title: OpenBrain Capabilities Section
description: The capabilities section of 00_index/vault.config.yml. Every capability ships disarmed; anything missing or malformed reads as disarmed.

hooks.description: Wires Open Brain into the events of the host AI CLI. Reads the vault only and costs nothing.

capture.description: Fills the staging area with candidates. Nothing reaches the kernel without human validation.

transcripts.description: Reads session transcripts from consented directories, which normally sit outside the vault.

roots.description: Directories explicitly consented to. An empty list means nothing is ever read.

redact.description: Strip secrets and obvious identifiers before writing anything into the vault.

classifier.description: Asks a model to classify staged candidates. The only capability that costs money.

daily_call_budget.description: Hard cap on model calls per day. A run stops when the budget is spent.

learning.description: Decision journal and sensors, plus the two child capabilities that draw conclusions from them.

evaluate.description: Evaluate beliefs and move their confidence. Requires enabled to be true.

consolidate.description: The only subtractive operation. Requires enabled to be true, and never arms implicitly.
